versions.changelog:
Initial release of dataset-creation-training skill, covering the full data workflow:

- Provides end-to-end guidance for building, cleaning, annotating, splitting, and training on custom datasets.
- Supports data collection from multiple sources (public, web, internal, annotation, synthetic).
- Ensures quality with best practices: data splitting, documentation, versioning, class balance, and quality assurance.
- Explains format standardization for Alpaca, ShareGPT, ChatML, and JSONL.
- Includes workflow and code samples for practical dataset preparation and integration with training pipelines.
